from moto import mock_ses

@mock_ses
def test():

entries.author: teacher
entries.content: Root cause: SES mocked all regions into a single `"global"` backend — `moto/ses/responses.py` hardcoded `ses_backends[self.current_account]["global"]` and the `BackendDict` in `moto/ses/models.py` was built with `use_boto3_regions=False, additional_regions=["global"]`, so state set in one region leaked into every other region. Fix: the response's `backend` property now resolves `ses_backends[self.current_account][self.region]` (matching SNS's pattern), and the `BackendDict` now uses the default boto3 region set (keeping `"global"` as an additional region for backward compatibility); the docstring example in `SESBackend` was updated to show a real region. Verified with a multi-region repro script and the existing `tests/test_ses` suite (all tests pass except 5 SNS-feedback tests that already failed on the baseline due to an unrelated SQS resource issue).
